cohort: 284 pregnant women with small-for-gestational-age fetuses at or beyond 37 weeks gestation
finding: Oral misoprostol for labor induction in SGA pregnancies at or beyond 37 weeks gestation is comparable to dinoprostone and planned primary cesarean section in terms of neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Oral misoprostol for labor induction in SGA near-term and term pregnancies resulted in similar rates of cesarean sections after labor induction compared to dinoprostone and primary cesarean section.
